title: CLO 2024 Academic Month: 3D Technology Supports the Traditional Clothing Foreign Trade Industry
description: Review of CLO Academic Month 2024! The presentation of 3D products to our colleagues. 4. The outlook on the future. ## Guangdong Provincial Law The Guangdong Provincial Law was established in 1949. As I just mentioned, we are a state-owned enterprise that is the first to engage in foreign trade in the clothing industry in Huanan. We have more than 500 fabric factories and more than 200 cotton factories. Our company serves as the vice-chairman of the China Provincial Exports and Exports Association. Notably, Tongzhuang and Niuzai are the leading companies in China. Our company produced the first China-exported jeans and has branches in many places, including the United States, Singapore, Shanghai, and Ireland. ## Adoption of 3D Technology Our company has been using 3D technology for a relatively long time. We started using 3D in 2008 because the company's leaders foresaw its future utility. Initially, we utilized Optex, specifically TD3. Later, in 2018, we began using Claw, which represented a comprehensive improvement. We have also started to employ more well-known 3D software in the industry. Our team has been expanding, and we have obtained various certifications from major customers. ## Growth of 3D Samples From 2017 to 2023, we have observed a significant change in sample usage. Our physical samples have been constantly decreasing, while our 3D samples have been consistently increasing. Various customers have been using 3D samples, and since 2008, the growth in 3D sample usage has been substantial. In 2019, due to the pandemic, the use of 3D samples grew rapidly. Although our clothing industry faced challenges during this period, we adopted a virtual skin approach, ensuring that our production could continue uninterrupted. ### Comparison of 3D and Traditional Samples We conducted a comparison between 3D samples and traditional samples. The online research and development for 3D has been compressed to 3 to 7 days. In the traditional industry, the entire process takes 15 to 60 days, significantly highlighting the efficiency gained through 3D technology. Not only has the time been reduced, but costs have also been compressed, leading to an increased utilization of 3D technology. ## Market Challenges and Innovation 3D technology has played a crucial role in promoting our clothing industry. The current market is consumer-driven, with a notable decline in purchasing power and a rise in new customer experiences. Our brand faces high storage pressures and environmental and social responsibility challenges. Orders have shifted from large to small, reflecting a more conservative market attitude. Consequently, competition among foreign trade companies has intensified. As the global economy becomes increasingly integrated, the Chinese foreign trade industry encounters numerous challenges. Continuous innovation and breakthroughs are essential for improving competitiveness amid market changes. 3D technology offers a new avenue to shorten development cycles and reduce costs, enabling our designers to present samples from design to final product more rapidly. ## Environmental Benefits of 3D Technology 3D technology significantly reduces the costs associated with samples, logistics, and overall development stages, enhancing our competitiveness. Furthermore, it optimizes inventory management, as physical samples require substantial storage space. By utilizing 3D, we can store digital samples, cutting down on material waste and aligning with environmental protection concepts. Given that material waste occurs during sample production, 3D technology allows for a more sustainable approach, reflecting our company's social responsibility. It enables us to present our products to customers in a more engaging manner, utilizing a single model to showcase various fabrics and colors. This capability attracts new customers, especially younger consumers who value high-tech experiences. ## Marketing and Customer Interaction The integration of 3D technology with social media and online marketing enhances user interaction and increases brand exposure on the internet. The low costs associated with 3D production stem from savings in logistics, physical samples, and production facilities. The speed of production has drastically improved; from fabric creation to sample production now takes just two hours, with modifications being easy and quick. 3D samples can be adjusted and modified at any time, and they facilitate better communication with customers. We can present a diversity of our products using various forms, enhancing customer interaction and creating a more digitized experience. The collection and analysis of 3D data also support development efforts, particularly in addressing environmental concerns. ## Showcasing Our 3D Products Next, we will showcase some of our team's 3D products. We typically align our offerings with customer needs, leveraging different 3D display techniques. Our 3D store features a variety of clothing styles and effects, allowing customers to visualize our products without the need for physical samples. For example, we can demonstrate different washing effects and fabric textures through our 3D models. This comparison between physical and 3D samples allows for immediate feedback and modifications based on customer preferences. ## Future Outlook Looking ahead, we anticipate continuous optimization of our 3D software, particularly with Cloud's ongoing collaboration. The integration of technologies like AI and big data will enhance our 3D design capabilities, making them more intelligent and automated. We aim to utilize VR and AR technologies to promote our virtual samples more effectively within the global market. I believe that 3D design will become a standard tool in the clothing industry, driving digital transformation. Our company will continue to test fabrics before developing samples, streamlining the modeling process. ## Impact on Employment and Talent Development As we embrace 3D technology, we foresee changes in employment, particularly in design roles. Designers will benefit from the ability to see their styles in 3D, enhancing their creativity. The emergence of new job opportunities, such as 3D consultants and 3D printers, will further enrich the talent pool. Training and education in 3D technology will be vital for attracting skilled professionals. Our foreign trade enterprises must leverage 3D technology to improve productivity, reduce costs, and create visually appealing marketing materials that captivate potential clients. ## Conclusion In conclusion, our company is committed to fostering a culture of innovation and learning. We welcome individuals who are eager to join our journey toward integrating 3D technology into the clothing industry. Together, we can drive significant advancements in product design, production efficiency, and market competitiveness. Thank you for your attention. ```
